title: Bryan Johnson: Kernel Brain-Computer Interfaces | Lex Fridman Podcast #186
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Bryan Johnson, founder of Kernel and previously Braintree, about brain-computer interfaces and Kernel's non-invasive brain monitoring hardware. It covers what the devices can do today and the company's plans.
why: Cited as an accessible overview of Kernel's technology whenever its brain-sensing helmets come up.

quote.text: this recent podcast episode with the CEO is a good start
